title: Closing and Funding Right of Rescission
content:
**Rule.** Where a Closing and Funding engagement carries the right of rescission, the borrower may rescind for the method's rescission period of specific business days after the latest of signing, delivery of the Notice of Right to Cancel and delivery of the material disclosures. A specific business day is every calendar day except Sundays and the US federal public holidays.

**Counting.** Count specific business days forward from the signing date, which is day zero; the rescission expiration date is the third such day, and rescission is possible until midnight of that day.

**Who and how.** Only the borrower (any one of the borrowers with an ownership interest) can rescind, in writing; Larkspur records it and returns the wire if one was sent.

**Waiver.** A rescission waiver is allowed only for a bona fide personal financial emergency stated in a dated, signed statement from every borrower; a printed waiver form is never accepted.

**No rescission.** Purchases, second homes and investment properties carry no rescission.

## Counting illustration (hypothetical, no federal holiday in the span)

| Signing date (day zero) | Day 1 | Day 2 | Day 3 = expiration date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Thursday | Friday | Saturday | Monday (Sunday is skipped) |
| Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday |

In the first row the borrower may rescind until midnight on Monday.

## Waiver judgement

| Waiver presented | Accepted? |
|---|---|
| dated, signed statement of a bona fide personal financial emergency from every borrower | Yes |
| such a statement from only one of two borrowers | No |
| printed waiver form | No, never |
